text:
maya: quick question — are we comfortable shipping the new telemetry 'verbose' option by default in the console? main worry is engineers toggling it and accidentally exposing PII in logs.

sam: I'm leaning no. default should be compact/aggregated. verbose only via explicit opt-in or short-lived token. :warning:

kevin: agree. also quota implications — verbose will blow through tokens and retention. we need per-route budget and backpressure so a single noisy route doesn't tank the pipeline.

jess: UX thought — rather than a toggle buried in settings, add a one-click "start debug session" that creates an ephemeral token and shows a clear banner: "unredacted data visible for 15m". include audit link.

olivia: for debugging we need more than aggregate counters though. proposal: two modes — compact (counts, latencies, top-errors) and trace-lite (anonymized snippets + provenance ids). full-raw only via ephemeral token + RBAC.

maya: example config I'm imagining:
```json
{"telemetry": {"mode": "compact|trace-lite|verbose", "ephemeral_debug_ttl_secs": 900}}
```

sam: +1 to trace-lite. important it still strips emails/credit-cards by default. we should run a small classifier stage before any console storage.

kevin: classifier is ok but it's never perfect. we need a circuit: if classifier confidence < 0.95, auto-mask and increment a metric so SREs can see false-positive/negative rates.

jess: question for rollout — do we flip compact default in prod and run a canary for 2 weeks, or ship both and default to compact for new tenants only?

maya: prefer new-tenants default = compact, existing tenants untouched, and a migration opt-in with an experimentation flag. gives us telemetry on developer confusion and support hits.

olivia: ops notes — ephemeral tokens must be bounded by both TTL and owner identity; store audit event with: who, route, token_id, TTL, sampling_rate. no plaintext payload persisted.

kevin: sampling_rate tie-in: trace-lite should be sampled at route-level percentiles, configurable in console with a clear estimated cost meter. UI should say "estimated monthly events: ~3k".

sam: also add server-side quota: if verbose usage > X per-tenant, auto-throttle to trace-lite and notify tenant owner. prevents runaway bills.

jess: will work with design on banners and the "Start debug session" flow. also want a tiny confirmation modal: checkbox "I understand unredacted data will be visible" + link to audit log.

maya: ops/infra ask — can deploy-bot emit a deployment note when the feature gates flip so oncall sees traffic pattern changes?

deploy-bot: prod-feature-switch: telemetry_compact_default -> enabled for new-tenants at 2026-04-02T08:30Z by @maya.

olivia: last item: logs retention. compact should keep aggregated metrics for 365 days; trace-lite events 30 days; verbose 7 days and accessible only through legal/supported workflows.

kevin: sounds good. I'll draft the API surface for per-route telemetry config and the quota enforcement plan.

maya: perfect — put the plan in a short RFC and we'll triage for the next infra sprint. thanks folks :tada:
